messages:
jamie (product): ok team — dropping the PRD + rollout sketch here. need fast feedback on: scope trimming for v1, pinned-version rules, rollback windows, and experiment cadence for 2-week canaries. cc @priya @matt
priya (eng): skimmed — looks good overall. question: do we force tenant pinning for all enterprise customers or opt-in? that changes infra work by ~2w.
matt (eng-ml): leaning opt-in for now. forcing pins increases storage / operator surface. we can offer a migration tool + one-click pin in console.
jamie (product): agree opt-in as long as acceptance criteria include explicit SLA and single-click rollback for pinned tenants. add to PRD?
danielle (pm): added a short acceptance list to the PRD draft: 1) canary traffic routing, 2) rollback <5min to previous model, 3) observability per-tenant (latency/cost), 4) experiment metrics view. can we get edge case on mixed-pin traffic?
olivia (sre): mixed-pin is the tricky one. we should route by policy order: pinned -> tenant default -> global fallback. and we must surface head-of-line queueing in the dashboard. otherwise tails blow up.
priya (eng): proposed experiment schedule: week 0 internal dev-only; week 1-2 5% customers (low-traffic); week 3 ramp to 25% if error rate <0.5% and 99th latency < target; week 4 monitor then opt-in open. rollback gates: if error-rate delta > 0.3% absolute OR regression in quality tests -> immediate rollback.
matt (eng-ml): add model-quality litmus: run regression eval suite on sample prompts every hour during canary. if nll increases or rouge drops beyond threshold -> fail. also add KV-cache warmup step to avoid cold-start quality blips.
jamie (product): nice. can we capture the config as a small example to include in the PRD? that helps infra + SRE to implement defaults.
priya (eng): putting a minimal config snippet below:
```json
{
  "experiment": "release-runway-2026-03",
  "stages": [
    {"name":"dev","pct":0,"duration_days":7},
    {"name":"canary","pct":5,"duration_days":14},
    {"name":"ramp","pct":25,"duration_days":7},
    {"name":"open","pct":100}
  ],
  "rollback_triggers": {
    "error_rate_delta": 0.003,
    "latency_99p_threshold_ms": 200,
    "quality_regression_pct": 1.0
  },
  "pin_policy": "opt-in",
  "pin_ttl_days": 90
}
```
olivia (sre): small note: latency_99p_threshold should be per-model and per-region. also we need a kill-switch: /release-runway/abort that SRE can flip.
jamie (product): added kill-switch to PRD + operational runbook. danielle — please add a checklist item for customer communication when a tenant is pinned or unpinned.
danielle (pm): done. also proposing a customer-visible timeline widget in console showing pin TTL and next eval date.
matt (eng-ml): edge-case: what if a pinned tenant's pinned model is removed from the catalog (EOL)? policy: auto-fallback to latest compatible variant and notify tenant with 30-day grace. include that in PRD.
priya (eng): agree on EOL policy. infra will emit a warning metric and a tenant-notify event.
deploy-bot: scheduled: release-runway-2026-03 feature-branch build 0.9 -> staging at 2026-03-11T18:20:00Z :hourglass_flowing_sand:
olivia (sre): preflight checklist before canary start: config validated, regression suite green, canary dashboards created, paging rules set, kill-switch tested. want one more +1 from infra on autoscaler safety.
priya (eng): autoscaler safety checks in place. will run a load sweep during dev week.
jamie (product): thanks all — pls add any final acceptance edge-cases as comments in the PRD doc. goal: ship canary by 2026-03-18 if we stay green. :rocket:
__notes: This thread is a PRD + rollout coordination discussion focused on scope, pin policies, rollback criteria, experiment schedule, and operational safeguards. Messages are short, informal and include a small JSON config snippet and bot message.
